sourceTitle: Drake; or, the Transfer of the Trident: A National Drama
description: "Drake; or, The Transfer of the Trident: A National Drama" by William MacOubrey is a historical drama written in the late 19th century. The play focuses on the exploits of Sir Francis Drake during the reign of Queen Elizabeth I, exploring themes of national pride and maritime conflict with Spain.
